official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: HMLR INSPIRE monthly release represents previous-month data
HMLR monthly geometry therefore has an explicit snapshot epoch
EA timestamped DTM survey date can differ by location
EA timestamped dataset metadata must be consulted for actual survey epoch
cross-source dates can therefore differ materially
epoch mismatch must be surfaced rather than hidden in a single confidence score
candidate identity and coordinates are still required before any epoch can be bound to a parcel
quality_effect: Adds explicit temporal-alignment acceptance rules for each real candidate.
